analyst.summary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions has recently turned profitable after a period of losses, but its profit margin remains extremely thin and revenue growth has been essentially flat over the past three years. The company also carries a meaningfully pledged promoter stake and is in the middle of a multi-entity merger that adds further uncertainty to its numbers. We rate this a Sell given the combination of thin margins, a governance flag, and limited visibility into the post-merger run-rate.
